_comment: Blog posts tied to Instagram creatives, published by website/tools/blog_sync.py. An entry with wp_id only attaches the creative to an existing post. The rest are whole posts: title and lead come from the creative and its caption (his own words), the paragraphs expand them in the blog's existing voice. The post is dated to the Instagram post.

posts.title: You don’t have to keep carrying the armor
posts.lead: Fear can protect you from getting hurt — and also protect you from being truly alive.
paras: Jo deewar aapne kabhi khud ko bachane ke liye banayi thi, wo galat nahi thi. Us waqt shayad wahi sahi tha — kisi pe zyada bharosa na karna, sab kuch akele sambhalna, har baat pehle se soch lena.
Lekin jo cheez past mein aapko protect karti thi, wahi aaj aapko rok bhi sakti hai. Armor chot se bachata hai — par kisi ko aapke kareeb bhi nahi aane deta.
Healing ka matlab armor phenk dena nahi hai. Healing hai ye pehchanna ki kab use utaarna safe hai — aur kis ke saamne.

posts.title: Change feels like loss before it feels like freedom
posts.lead: Sometimes letting go is not losing yourself — it’s finally choosing yourself.
paras: Expectations, people pleasing, “log kya kahenge” — inhe chhodna aasaan nahi lagta. Kyunki ye sirf aadatein nahi hain, saalon se ye aapki pehchaan ka hissa rahi hain.
Isliye jab aap badalna shuru karti hain, pehle azaadi nahi, khaali-pan mehsoos hota hai. Lagta hai kuch kho gaya hai.
Wo ehsaas galat nahi hai — wo bas beech ka raasta hai. Jo jagah khaali hui hai, wahi dheere-dheere aapki apni jagah banegi.

posts.title: The version of you who survived deserves thanks, not judgement
posts.lead: Be proud of the woman who kept going.
paras: Hum aksar apne purane version ko judge karte hain — “maine itna kyun saha?”, “pehle kyun nahi samjhi?”
Par us waqt aapke paas jitni samajh thi, jitni himmat thi, aapne usi se kaam chalaya. Aapne sirf survive nahi kiya — aapne khud ko sambhala, seekha aur grow kiya.
Aaj jo aap jaanti hain, wo usi ki wajah se jaanti hain. Use thoda credit dijiye. Wo deserve karti hai.

posts.title: Not every silence needs an explanation
posts.lead: Sometimes the healthiest thing you can do is stop assuming.
paras: Message ka reply nahi aaya, aur dimaag kahaniyan banane lagta hai — “kya main enough nahi hoon?”, “kya wo naraz hai?”, “kya maine kuch galat kaha?”
Zyada tar baar silence ka matlab rejection nahi hota. Saamne wala thaka hua ho sakta hai, busy ho sakta hai, ya bas apne aap mein ho sakta hai.
Har chuppi ko assumptions se mat bhariye. Logon ko space dijiye — aur khud ko peace.

posts.title: You are allowed to change the rules
posts.lead: What you believed years ago may not be what you need today.
paras: “Achhi ladki aisa nahi karti.” “Pehle sabka khayal, phir apna.” Kuch rules humne tab maan liye the jab humare paas koi aur option nahi tha.
Wo rules us waqt survive karne ke liye the. Par jo kabhi zaroori tha, zaroori nahi ki aaj bhi wahi aapke liye sahi ho.
Aap ab zyada jaanti hain. Aap grow kar chuki hain. Aap dobara choose kar sakti hain — aur alag choose kar sakti hain.

posts.title: “Why me?” keeps you stuck. “What now?” moves you forward
posts.lead: Life becomes lighter when you stop asking why it happened and start asking what you can do next.
paras: “Mere saath hi kyun?” — ye sawaal bilkul natural hai. Dard mein sabse pehle yahi aata hai.
Mushkil tab hoti hai jab hum isi sawaal mein ruk jaate hain. Iska koi jawab nahi milta, aur hum wahin khade reh jaate hain.
“Ab kya?” ek chhota sa shift hai. Ye dard ko chhota nahi karta — bas aapka agla kadam aapke haath mein wapas de deta hai.

posts.title: Like a butterfly, you have to leave the cocoon behind
posts.lead: Growth begins when you dare to leave what once felt safe.
paras: Cocoon butterfly ki dushman nahi thi. Wahi jagah thi jahan woh surakshit rahi, jahan uska badalna shuru hua.
Hamari zindagi mein bhi kuch aadatein, rishte aur soch aisi hi hoti hain — ek waqt par unhone humein bachaya. Par jo jagah kabhi safe thi, zaroori nahi ki aaj bhi wahi aapke liye sahi ho.
Bahar nikalna dar lagta hai, kyunki naya abhi jaana-pehchana nahi hai. Khud par bharosa rakhiye, aur us zindagi ke liye jagah banaiye jiski aap hakdaar hain.

posts.title: You are not too much
posts.lead: Sometimes you simply gave your heart to someone who didn’t have the capacity to give the same in return.
paras: “Main zyada expect karti hoon.” “Shayad main hi too much hoon.” Ek adhoore rishte ke baad hum aksar khud ko hi chhota kar lete hain.
Kabhi-kabhi baat aapki zaroorton ki nahi hoti, saamne wale ki kshamta ki hoti hai. Pyaar, dhyaan aur izzat chahna “too much” nahi hai.
Kisi aur ki seemaon mein fit hone ke liye khud ko kabhi chhota mat kijiye.

posts.title: Protect the first hour
posts.lead: Your first hour is not selfish. It’s self-leadership.
paras: Aap din kaise shuru karti hain, aksar wahi tay karta hai ki baaki din aap kaise jeeti hain.
Aankh khulte hi phone, sabke messages, sabki zarooratein — aur khud ki baari aate-aate din khatam ho jaata hai.
Pehla ghanta apne liye rakhiye: thoda paani, thodi saans, thoda likhna. Baaki sab us bache hue waqt mein adjust ho jaata hai — aur aap zyada shaant hokar sabke liye maujood hoti hain.

posts.title: Healing is not becoming someone new
posts.lead: It’s returning to yourself.
paras: Kabhi-kabhi life ke anubhavon ke baad hum apni hi needs, sapno aur pehchaan se door ho jaate hain.
Healing ka matlab perfect banna nahi hai. Iska matlab hai dheere-dheere us insaan se dobara judna jo aap thi — us se pehle jab aapne maan liya tha ki aapko koi aur banna padega.
Aapko naya banne ki zaroorat nahi. Bas khud ke paas wapas aana hai.

posts.title: Love is not enough on its own
posts.lead: Healthy relationships need respect, effort, trust and emotional safety.
paras: Hum maan lete hain ki agar pyaar hai, toh sab theek ho jayega. Par pyaar ek beej hai — use paudha banne ke liye roz paani chahiye.
Izzat, koshish, bharosa aur emotional safety — yahi woh paani hai. Inke bina sabse gehra pyaar bhi sookhne lagta hai.
Pyaar tabhi khoobsurat hai, jab dono use nurture karein.

posts.title: Peacekeeping is not peace
posts.lead: Keeping everyone comfortable by disappearing is not harmony. It is a quiet form of absence.
paras: Ghar mein sab khush rahein, isliye aap chup reh jaati hain. Har jhagde ko aap apne andar sokh leti hain — family ki “shock absorber”.
Bahar se lagta hai sab shaant hai. Par jis shaanti mein aap khud hi gayab hain, woh peace nahi, peacekeeping hai — aur uski keemat aap chuka rahi hain.
Asli shaanti mein aap bhi kamre mein maujood hoti hain — apni awaaz aur apni zaroorton ke saath.

posts.title: Stop calling it rejection — sometimes it’s redirection
posts.lead: What didn’t work out may be making space for what will.
paras: Jab koi rishta, naukri ya mauka haath se nikal jaata hai, dil kehta hai — “main kaafi nahi thi.”
Par jo dard rejection jaisa lagta hai, woh kai baar ek mod hota hai — growth, peace, self-love aur naye mauko ki taraf.
Dard ko maaniye, use jaldi se positive mat banaiye. Phir ek sawaal poochhiye: is band darwaaze ne meri zindagi mein kis cheez ke liye jagah banayi hai?

posts.title: Khud ko sambhalna selfishness nahi hai
posts.lead: Apne liye time nikalna bhi self-respect hai.
paras: Hum mein se kai women ko sikhaya gaya ki apne liye waqt nikalna swaarth hai — pehle sab, phir main.
Par jab aap apna khayal rakhti hain, aap Bhagwan ki sabse khoobsurat rachna ka khayal rakh rahi hoti hain — aur phir har us cheez ke liye behtar maujood hoti hain jo aapke liye maayne rakhti hai.
Exercise, neend, ek shaant cup chai, ek “nahi” — self-care inhi chhoti chhoti cheezon se banta hai.

posts.title: Small and consistent beats big and occasional
posts.lead: The version of you that you want is not built in one dramatic weekend. It is built in unremarkable Tuesdays.
paras: Hum badlav ko ek bade din ki tarah dekhte hain — naya saal, naya Monday, ek dramatic decision.
Par asli badlav saadharan dinon mein hota hai — jab kuch khaas nahi ho raha, phir bhi aap apna chhota sa vaada nibhaati hain.
Aadat ka sabse chhota version chuniye aur use pakad ke rakhiye. Aapka sabse chhota agla kadam kya hai?

posts.title: Green flags to look for in a relationship
posts.lead: Not every healthy relationship is perfect.
paras: Hum red flags pehchaanna seekh lete hain, par green flags ke baare mein kam sochte hain.
Asli green flags: izzat, emotional safety, consistency, aur jhagde ke baad rishta jodne ki koshish. Chhote vaade nibhaana, aur asehmati mein bhi shaant rehna.
Aisa rishta chuniye jahan shaanti naturally mehsoos ho — kabhi-kabhi nahi.

posts.title: You don’t need to reopen the wound to prove it hurt
posts.lead: You already know what you went through.
paras: Kabhi-kabhi hum dard ko baar-baar yaad karte hain, sunaate hain, dohraate hain — jaise uske bina koi maanega hi nahi ki humein chot lagi thi.
Aapka anubhav sach tha, chahe aap use roz na dohraayein. Use sach saabit karne ke liye ghaav ko khula rakhna zaroori nahi.
Healing ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai — wapas na jaana. Kahani ko yaad rakhiye, par usme rehna band kijiye.

posts.title: Stop shrinking to fit rooms you have already outgrown
posts.lead: You don’t need to become smaller to be accepted.
paras: Kabhi-kabhi hum acceptance ke liye apni needs, sapne aur awaaz chhoti kar dete hain.
Par jo jagah aapko chhota karke hi rakh sakti hai, woh aapki jagah nahi rahi.
Agar koi space aapki growth ko limit kar raha hai, shayad waqt hai aisi jagah chunne ka jahan aap badh sakein, saans le sakein aur khud ho sakein.

posts.title: Missing someone is not a reason to go back
posts.lead: Missing them is a feeling. Going back is a decision.
paras: Kabhi-kabhi hum kisi ko miss karte hain, lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki humein wahi rishta ya wahi situation wapas chahiye.
Aap yaadon ko miss kar sakti hain, aur phir bhi apni peace chun sakti hain.
Woh chuniye jo aapki peace ko bachaaye — woh nahi jo purana ghaav phir se khol de. Kuch chapters band hone ke liye hote hain, dohraane ke liye nahi.

posts.title: Everything looks fine — so why do I still feel empty?
posts.lead: You don’t have to figure everything out alone.
paras: Achha parivaar, stable career, achhe dost, aaram ki cheezein — sab kuch hai. Phir bhi andar kuch khaali sa lagta hai, aur hum is ehsaas ko “ungrateful” samajh kar dabaa dete hain.
Yeh khaalipan kamzori nahi, ek signal hai — ki kahin na kahin aap apni needs, apne sapno ya apni awaaz se door ho gayi hain.
Ise akele samajhna zaroori nahi. Sahi guidance, sachchi baatcheet aur ek supportive community se safar halka ho jaata hai. Agla chapter ek chhote faisle se shuru ho sakta hai — khud ko chunne se.

posts.title: You cannot step into a new chapter while holding on to the old one
posts.lead: Sometimes, moving forward simply means putting down what no longer belongs in your next chapter.
paras: Purani galtiyan, purane beliefs, toxic rishte, “log kya kahenge” — hum inhe ek bojh ki tarah saath le kar chalte rehte hain, aur phir sochte hain ki naya shuru kyun nahi ho raha.
Naye chapter mein kadam rakhne ke liye pehle haath khaali karne padte hain. Iska matlab purana bhool jaana nahi — bas use ab saath le kar na chalna.
Aaj ek cheez chuniye jo aapke agle chapter ka hissa nahi hai. Use dheere se neeche rakh dijiye.

posts.title: Healthy love feels like…
posts.lead: Healthy love is not just saying “I love you”.
paras: Clarity — mujhe pata hai main is rishte mein kahan khadi hoon. Consistency — baatein aur kaam kuch din nahi, roz ek jaise rehte hain.
Emotional safety — main apni feelings bina judge, insult ya reject hone ke dar ke keh sakti hoon. Mutual efforts — rishta ek insaan ke kandhon par nahi chalta.
Healthy love shor nahi karta, sukoon deta hai.

posts.title: Start the day answering to yourself
posts.lead: A strong mindset begins when you stop leaving yourself last.
paras: Hum din bhar sabke sawaalon ka jawab dete hain — ghar, kaam, phone. Par apne sawaalon ka jawab dena bhool jaate hain.
Teen sawaal kaafi hain: Aaj mujhe kya chahiye? Main kya mehsoos kar rahi hoon? Mere liye sach mein kya zaroori hai?
Jab aap pehle khud se baat karti hain, din aapka hota hai — warna din sabka hota hai, aur aap bas usme fit hoti rehti hain.

posts.title: You cannot heal in the environment that keeps hurting you
posts.lead: Sometimes, choosing peace means choosing distance.
paras: Ek ghaav ko bharne ke liye use baar-baar chhoona band karna padta hai. Mann ke ghaav bhi aise hi hote hain.
Agar wahi log, wahi baatein, wahi mahaul har baar chot ko taaza kar dete hain, toh sirf “strong” rehne se healing nahi hogi.
Doori hamesha rishta todna nahi hoti. Kam milna, kuch topics par baat na karna, apne liye alag jagah banana — yeh bhi doori hai. Peace chuniye. Behtar chuniye. Khud ko chuniye.

posts.title: The child inside you is still waiting to hear: it was not your fault
posts.lead: Healing begins with a powerful affirmation: “I am free from the weight of blame.”
paras: Bachpan mein jo hua, uska bojh kai baar hum badi umar tak uthate rehte hain — jaise galti hamari hi thi.
Aapke andar ki woh chhoti bachchi abhi bhi masoomiyat se chamakti hai. Use bas woh sunna hai jo shayad kisi ne kabhi kaha nahi: “yeh tumhari galti nahi thi.”
Aaj use yeh khud kahiye. Healing wahin se shuru hoti hai jahan blame khatam hota hai.

posts.title: Grief is love with nowhere left to go
posts.lead: When someone we deeply love is no longer with us, the love doesn’t simply disappear.
paras: Hum ab bhi unse baat karna chahte hain, unka khayal rakhna chahte hain, unke saath cheezein baantna chahte hain.
Jo pyaar hum ab bhi mehsoos karte hain aur jo insaan ab pahunch se door hai — un dono ke beech ki khaali jagah ko hi grief kehte hain.
Grief koi problem nahi jise jaldi solve karna hai. Woh pyaar hi hai, bas ab naya roop dhoondh raha hai — ek yaad, ek rasm, unke naam par ek kaam.
